title: Victoria Quay International RoRo Terminal Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Automotive and Ro-Ro Terminal at the Port of Fremantle
acquirers: Victoria Quay International RoRo Terminal Pty Ltd
targets: Automotive and Ro-Ro Terminal at the Port of Fremantle

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Closing date for further submissions from interested parties regarding draft key performance indicators.
Former proposed decision date of 26 February delayed at the request of VQIRT.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition, subject to a 87B undertaking accepted by the ACCC.
